title: 00-ideation-brief.md (plan) runtime body-structure contract
description: Hook-consumable runtime artifact for plan-tree 00-ideation-brief.md files. Frozen-post-Session-1 body with amendment-pointer-block prepend pattern. Conditional plan-folder quartet member (gates at planned → in-progress for manifest.research_driven: true).
matcher_rationale: The matching registry entry is the frontmatter type registry, which declares the ideation-brief type and names this contract as its body_structure_contract. The plans pillar's plan_folder_quartet declares only `required` (spec.md, tasks.md, handoff.md, manifest.json) and carries no conditional slot: the ideation brief is not a quartet member, and the conditional_required block below is advisory-by-declaration with no write-time enforcer.

_design_notes.consumer: librarian plan-index; body-immutability is documentary — no write-time DENY (no immutability guard branch), per evolution_protocol
_design_notes.lockstep_pair: governance/frontmatter-rules.json :: types.ideation-brief (the type registration) + governance/plans-rules.json :: plan_folder_quartet (the quartet this file is the conditional companion to, not a member of)
_design_notes.evolution_protocol: Body frozen post-Session-1; amendments via prepended amendment-pointer-block referencing the canonical reference. Body preserved as the Session 0 research record. R-37 atomic lockstep — documentary-by-design (the frozen-body + amendment-pointer-block protocol is the lockstep record, NOT a write-time DENY).

frozen_rationale: Body preserved as Session 0 research record; subsequent decision shifts captured via amendment-pointer-blocks rather than in-place edits.
amendment_pattern: amendment-pointer-block at top of body referencing canonical reference; body preserved as Session 0 research record
